listing.name: Glider PRO / Aerofoil (elasota)
listing.summary: Fly through Glider PRO’s houses with Aerofoil’s gamepad support and house editor. Portcove can manage a separate Windows copy or launch one you prepared.

steps.title: Prepare a separate copy from upstream
steps.instruction: Choose the official package ending in -win64.zip and extract it to a separate folder. Keep Aerofoil.exe and its packaged companions together. The tools ZIP is a separate download for importing additional original-format content. For a prepared copy, use documented literal arguments if your chosen version needs them. Close the player before applying upstream updates.

references.title: Keep custom houses and saved games
references.instruction: Aerofoil stores custom houses, saved games, scores, preferences, logs and exports in the Aerofoil folder in your Windows Documents location. Managed and prepared copies can share this profile. Back it up separately and check compatibility before changing versions.

data_locations: the actual Aerofoil folder in your Windows Documents location, including custom houses, saves, scores, preferences, logs and exports

preparation.title: Play the managed Windows copy
preparation.instruction: Choose Play to open the packaged houses. Aerofoil creates its player profile in your Windows Documents location. Use the separate upstream tools and a prepared copy if you want to import and manage other content outside this route.

warnings: Choose a short Windows library path so Aerofoil can open all of its packaged files.
